subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_ b _ p p p _ q p _ p b _ p _

options.text: b q b p b p
p b q p b q
p q b p q p
p q p p q b

solution:
Given :- _ b _ p p p _ q p _ p b _ p _

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) b q b p b p → **b** b **q** p p - p **b** q p **p** - p b **b** p **p**

2) p b q p b q → **p** b **b** p p - p **q** q p **p** - p b **b** p **q**

3) p q b p q p → **p** b **q** p p - p **b** q p **p** - p b **q** p **p**

 
• Here **"pbqpp"** is repeated.

4) p q p p q b → **p** b **q** p p - p **p** q p **p** - p b **q** p **b**

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of :- p b q p p - p b q p p - p b q p p

Hence, the correct answer is **"p q b p q p".**
